title: Sonoratek LLC — publisher of Connect Platform & Ring
description: Sonoratek LLC (Tempe, Arizona) publishes Connect Platform — an enterprise Erlang ASN.1/BERT realtime backend — and Ring, the open-source webOS that runs on Connect, Firebase, Supabase, Vercel, and k8s/Postgres.

hero.description: Sonoratek LLC is the publisher behind Connect Platform and Ring. Connect delivers commercial-grade Erlang realtime infrastructure; Ring is the open-source webOS that puts enterprise-class software within reach of every founder on the planet.

origin.title: Who we are
origin.subtitle: IT pathfinding from Phoenix Valley since 2013 — Connect for the wire, Ring for the product surface

crisis.title: Connect Platform
crisis.description: Connect Platform is Sonoratek’s commercial Erlang backend for high-availability enterprise workloads. It speaks ASN.1/BERT on the wire, and is built around OTP GenServer processes, pub/sub fan-out, durable snapshots, and other commercial-grade standards — the same class of realtime fabric used when Firebase-style latency is not enough.

liberation.title: Ring webOS
liberation.description: Ring is the open-source webOS that runs on Connect, Firebase, Supabase, Vercel, and k8s/Postgres. One white-label stack — entities, opportunities, store, messaging, wallet, docs — so founders ship niche products without rebuilding the platform from scratch.

gratitude.title: Sonoratek LLC
gratitude.description: Based in Tempe / Phoenix Valley, Arizona (1127 E Curry Rd #6, Tempe, AZ 85281), Sonoratek has helped companies automate, stay in the cloud, and ship digital products for over a decade. We publish Connect for enterprise realtime and Ring so every founder can operate with enterprise-class software.

mission.title: Our mission
mission.subtitle: Enterprise-class software for every founder
mission.vision: Connect carries the hard realtime path; Ring clones compose the product surface — AI-orchestrated, white-label, and deployable wherever the founder already runs.

unite.title: Realtime that scales
unite.description: Connect’s Erlang OTP stack — GenServer, pub/sub, snapshots, ASN.1/BERT — keeps high-concurrency collaboration fast and predictable for enterprise workloads.

democratize.title: webOS for founders
democratize.description: Ring packages marketplace, community, wallet, and AI-matching modules as an open-source webOS you can clone, customize, and host on Connect or commodity clouds.

endDeficit.title: No privilege tax
endDeficit.description: Enterprise patterns should not be reserved for Fortune 500 budgets. Ring + Connect close the gap between a founder’s idea and production-grade software.

impact.title: Deployments in the wild
impact.subtitle: Ring clones powered by Sonoratek’s publishing stack

story2.description: Independent network of Subaru enthusiasts, with opportunity feed for custom builds, used cars and parts listings and chat

story3.name: Pet Friend App
story3.description: Pet-friendly app for finding and sharing places, events, and promotions, with chat by pet-friendly maps

democratization.title: Sovereignty by technology
democratization.description: Ring gives founders technological independence: evolve the platform from ring-config and modules, not from a vendor roadmap. Connect stays the optional enterprise realtime backbone when HA and fan-out matter.
democratization.quote: Connect for commercial-grade Erlang realtime. Ring for the open-source webOS every founder can run on Connect, Firebase, Supabase, Vercel, or k8s/Postgres.

future.title: Future vision
future.description: Ask your Ring instance to add a capability in plain language — watch modules, contracts, and UI land with AI orchestration. Connect keeps the realtime path enterprise-ready while Ring evolves the product surface.
future.roadmap: From manual platform builds to AI-orchestrated white-label clones. From single-cloud lock-in to Connect + Firebase + Supabase + Vercel + k8s/Postgres. From scarce enterprise tooling to abundance for founders.

autonomous.title: AI autonomous evolution
autonomous.description: Platforms that extend themselves from natural-language requirements

learning.title: Inter-platform learning
learning.description: Ring instances share patterns so the next clone starts further ahead

adaptation.title: Realtime adaptation
adaptation.description: Product surfaces that evolve with usage while Connect holds the HA wire

thankYou.subtitle: Connect for the wire. Ring for the product. Sonoratek as publisher.
